name: Mahou Shoujo ga Zenra de Dogeza! ~Kutsujoku ni Nureru Gomennasai~
original_name: 魔法少女が全裸で土下座！ ～屈辱に濡れるごめんなさい～
source:
There is an evil society that is plotting the world's overthrow—Death Black.

They fought the Holy White, a justice organization run by magical girls, for days and nights, and despite their misfortunes, the townspeople feared them because of their threat. Such a society is supported by the science and technology group led by Hirai Genzou. Its scientific strength was so great that it was half a century ahead of modern science.

But Holy White did see the threat and ordered magical girls Acrylic Blue and Acrylic Red to attack, which resulted in the destruction of the research facilities. Genzou had lost many of his underlings and research resources, and even he himself was mortally wounded. He has undergone a remodeling surgery and has barely escaped with his life by becoming a monster, yet the losses were great... Awakened Genzou, in a rage, swears to take revenge on the magical girls who took from him so much. And not just ordinary revenge... To make them take off magical girls' trademark costumes with their own hands, while their faces are distorted by shame, and bend their knees and rub their heads against the floor.

Soiling their names, breaking their fame, humiliating ultimate apology.

...Nude genuflection!

Then Genzou was summoned by headquarters and was selected as the leader of the science and research group. Making full use of his position, he commences operations to make abhorred magical girls, Acrylic Blue and Acrylic Red, genuflect.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009996.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
有一个企图颠覆世界的邪恶组织——死亡黑。

他们与由魔法少女组成的正义组织圣洁白昼夜战斗；尽管自身遭遇不幸，城镇居民仍因其威胁而对他们感到恐惧。这个组织由平井源三领导的科学技术集团支援，其科学实力领先现代科学半个世纪。

但圣洁白察觉到了威胁，下令让魔法少女亚克力蓝和亚克力红发动攻击，结果研究设施被摧毁。源三失去了许多部下和研究资源，自己也身负重伤。他接受改造手术，变成怪物后才勉强捡回一条命，但损失十分惨重……苏醒后的源三怒火中烧，发誓要向夺走他一切的魔法少女复仇。而且不只是普通的复仇……他要让她们亲手脱下魔法少女的标志性服装，让她们羞愧得面容扭曲，跪下并把额头贴在地板上。

玷污她们的名声，摧毁她们的荣耀，施以屈辱至极的道歉。

……裸体下跪！

随后，源三被总部召回，并被任命为科学研究组的负责人。他充分利用自己的职位，开始策划让憎恨的魔法少女亚克力蓝和亚克力红下跪。
